messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a SURGEWAY cutover tonight at 02:00 UTC. Goal: enable `surgeway_enabled` with a staged ramp (0 -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%) over ~45m. We'll pin backend to v2.3.7-rc1 for the window and have immediate rollback to v2.3.6 if anything looks off. Need release + oncall acks and the preflight run 90m prior.

sam: ack from release lead. I'll own coordination and the manual smoke at each step.

anil: SRE ack. I'll attach SLO alarms and an automated gating rule: if p50 latency >200ms OR error rate >0.8% sustained for 5m, trigger rollback action.

leo: quick dev note — this deploy includes a small routing tweak; recommend priming the KV cache before the 02:00 start to avoid cold spikes. I'll run a priming job ~01:45.

maria: deploybot — can you run preflight now and after the staging promotion?

deploybot: Running preflight checks now. Command executed:
```
/deploybot preflight --service=api --version=v2.3.7-rc1 --flag=surgeway_enabled
```
Preflight summary: healthchecks OK, smoke tests passed (auth, write, read), canary error-rate=0.02%. No blocker flags.

sam: nice. timeline proposal: preflight @ 00:30 UTC, final thumbs @ 01:20 UTC, start ramp @ 02:00 UTC. Manual holdpoints at each percentage (1%, 5%). 15m soak at 5% before moving to 20%.

anil: I'll deploy the gating script. Auto-rollback action (if triggered) will: 1) set `surgeway_enabled` -> 0; 2) pin routing to v2.3.6; 3) notify #incidents and page oncall.

leo: cache priming job created (job id: prime-9832). I'll kick it off at 01:45.

maria: adding the exact deploybot commands here for runbook clarity:
```
# ramp steps (manual confirm at each)
/deploybot flag set surgeway_enabled 1 --percent 1
# wait 5-15m smoke
/deploybot flag set surgeway_enabled 2 --percent 5
# soak 15m, then
/deploybot flag set surgeway_enabled 3 --percent 20
```
If emergency: `/deploybot flag set surgeway_enabled 0 --force` + `/deploybot pin service api --version v2.3.6 --reason "emergency rollback"`

sam: we'll also do a small client-side canary: 5% of internal beta users hit new path with additional logging. I'll monitor logs.

anil: gating thresholds I'll program into the alert rule:
- p95 latency > 800ms for 3m -> auto-rollback
- error rate > 1% for 3m -> auto-rollback
- token error spike > 30% over baseline -> auto-rollback
I'll also add a test to suppress spurious alerts during the scheduled change window (02:00-04:00 UTC).

maria: links: runbook + artifacts
- Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/surgeway-cutover
- Telemetry dashboard: https://telemetry/redwood/surgeway?ts=1715009999
- Logs/artifacts: /artifacts/surgeway/1715009999

deploybot: Scheduled rollout job created (id: 98321). Will emit tick messages to this thread on each step.

leo: reminder: bump max_instances to 200 for the 2h window to avoid ASG throttles (ops change queued).

sam: copy. I'll handle client smoke and post screenshot artifacts to the logs link.

managers note: @product — FYI this is low-risk controlled ramp, ok to proceed.

anil: I'm oncall that night, will be monitoring the dashboards. Pager rotations updated.

maria: ok closing checklist: preflight 00:30, priming 01:45, final thumbs 01:20, start 02:00, holds at 1% and 5%, soak 15m at 5%. If all green, leave at 20% and follow up with postmortem.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

leo: priming started — job prime-9832 running :eyes:

deploybot: Preflight passed. Job 98321 scheduled for 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z (thread id 1715009999).

maria: thanks everyone. I'll pin this thread and post the release notes after the 20% point. If anything changes, post here immediately.

sam: saved artifacts to /artifacts/surgeway/1715009999/screenshots.zip

anil: added quick rollback runbook excerpt to the runbook link.

maria: anything else before we close?

leo: none from infra. good luck :coffee:

maria: closing — will reopen thread if we hit any holds or rollback. :white_check_mark:
